item.title: Hypersonic Supply Chain Attacks: One Solution That Didn’t Need to Know the Payload
item.description:

Date: April 22, 2026
Tags: ["Cybersecurity", "Artificial Intelligence", "Supply Chain Security", "Threat Detection"]
Summary:
  • Supply chain attacks now move at hypersonic speeds using AI automation.
  • Threat actors recently targeted core infrastructure like LiteLLM and Axios.
  • These zero-day attacks exploited trusted delivery channels and official vendor domains.
  • SentinelOne successfully blocked these threats without prior knowledge of the payloads.
  • Modern security must defend against autonomous agents moving faster than human response.
  • Organizations need defense architectures that stop unknown threats in real-time.
